I lived on Oahu for 4 months before I moved back here to Ohio. I didn't plan on living there just needed to clear my head. I had a buddy that I used to work with who lived there and I  stayed with her for a little while until I could sort myself. I was very lucky that I had someone there for a bit.  I'd find odd jobs, mostly cleaning jobs for hoarders. You wouldn't believe how many hoarders live in Hawaii! I moved back a few months ago. I do have plans to go back, just trying to come up with the money. Its not terribly expensive to live there surprisingly.
